text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Sev2 - elevated 5xx and request timeouts observed for /v1/generate. Alerts: p99 latency > 8s, error rate 5xx > 4% over 5m. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/timeout-regression • pager: oncall@mira
mira (oncall): ack. I'm looking at tracing now. grabbing p95/p99 dashboards
jon (sre): jumping in. I see a deploy completed ~3m before spike: canary rollout 2026-02-18T09:12Z. Correlates with increased tail latency and timeouts on gpu-pool-3
mira (oncall): confirmed p95 jumped from 320ms -> 1.2s, p99 -> 9.3s. Error rate 5xx (503) spike on gateway
sasha (eng): linking to trace sample: https://grafana/traces/abcd1234 lots of queue_wait and grpc reconnects. Possibly backlog in downstream kv-cache? seeing long scheduling waits on nodes: "enqueue_time" high
leo (prod): customer impact: several API keys hitting burst limits reported timeouts from partners in EU region. Will notify accounts after triage
mira (oncall): digging into pods on gpu-pool-3: kubectl logs show increased "rpc timeout" and several OOMAvoidKill warnings. Not seeing clear memory OOMs though
jon (sre): can we check steady-state qps vs batch sizes? Looks like a change in the canary altered batch window: newly deployed model variant has higher per-token CPU. config diff: https://git.redwood/rollouts/987 diff shows default_batch_ms 10 -> 50
mira (oncall): ah, that would increase batching wait but shouldn't blow p99 unless resource starved
sasha (eng): the canary also enabled kv-prefetch for long contexts; that increases KV cache misses and extra GPU memcpy calls. I'm suspecting combined effect: larger batch windows + kv-prefetch = longer prep time -> queueing
deploy-bot: Rollout 987 (canary) status: 50% traffic -> success. Trigger: merge commit 3f9a2
jon (sre): proposing immediate rollback of the canary to stop bleeding, we can re-evaluate config in a staging perf run
mira (oncall): agree, rolling back now. Initiating rollback via deploy-bot command
mira (oncall): /rollback rollout 987 --reason "p99 latency regression post-deploy"
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for rollout 987 by mira. Progress: reducing canary -> 0% over 2m. Observability: https://grafana/dashboards/rollout/987
mira (oncall): rollback in progress. Watching p99
jon (sre): tailing logs on nodes being drained: seeing graceful shutdowns and a few in-flight requests retried
sasha (eng): note: the change touched batching kernel selection. We'll add a guard in the rollout script to not increase default_batch_ms without perf signoff
mira (oncall): p99 trending down: 9.3s -> 2.1s in 90s. error rate dropping from 4.8% -> 0.6%
leo (prod): sending quick internal note to impacted partners: "We observed transient timeout spikes tied to a canary rollout. Traffic reverted; services recovering. We'll follow up with root cause within 24h." :email:
jon (sre): ramp-down completed. Rollout 987 -> 0% complete. deploy-bot confirms rollback finished
deploy-bot: Rollback complete for rollout 987. New active revision: 3f9a1
mira (oncall): metrics look mostly back to baseline but p99 still elevated for one replicaset (gpu-pool-3a). Investigating node-level throttling
jon (sre): found kernel spin on one host: /var/log/syslog showing NVML transient errors and high GPU memcpy times. Marking the node for cordon/drain
mira (oncall): cordon/drain initiated: kubectl cordon gpu-node-3a; kubectl drain gpu-node-3a --ignore-daemonsets
sasha (eng): we should also add a fast-fail fallback in routing policy: if p99 > 5s then divert to standby model variant (lower perf but stable)
mira (oncall): good idea. For now manual policy: routing switch to variant-stable in eu region
mira (oncall): /route switch eu /v1/generate -> model:variant-stable
deploy-bot: Route override applied by mira. Old route preserved for rollback
leo (prod): customer comms sent. Monitoring for support tickets. No major account escalations yet.
jon (sre): action items: (1) postmortem, (2) add rollout guard for batching and kv-prefetch combos, (3) add routing auto-fallback for p99 threshold, (4) repro in perf env with real traffic profile
sasha (eng): I'll own rollout guard and perf repro. assigning to sasha
mira (oncall): I'll draft incident summary and timeline. handing off to next oncall for overnight monitoring
mira (oncall): handing off to sasha (oncall coverage 09:45-17:45 UTC). Full timeline and logs: https://redwood/incidents/1876543210/notes
sasha (eng): ack takeover. will keep watch for 2h and escalate if p99 > 2s
leo (prod): adding a short customer bulletin for the status page
incident-bot: Incident updated: status -> mitigated. Severity -> Sev3. Pager cleared for mira
mira (oncall): thanks team. we'll follow up with full RCA and perf test results. closing thread when postmortem created
sasha (eng): noted. I put a stub postmortem ticket: https://tracker/tickets/INC-4521
mira (oncall): thread closed — last checks are green. Good job everyone :thumbsup:
